description: This file defines the SetTokenParser class in the Twig templating engine. It is responsible for parsing 'set' tags that assign values to variables within Twig templates.

classes.name: SetTokenParser
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractTokenParser to handle parsing of 'set' tags within Twig templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'set' tag in Twig, handling variable assignments, multi-target assignments, and block content.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines whether the current token indicates the end of a 'set' block by testing for 'endset'.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this parser, which is 'set'.
